flashcard.back: A polite way to ask someone to do something. Example: "Could you share your screen?"
To understand the requirements of a project. Example: "I need to scope the work first."
A short version shown first. Example: "I'll send a draft by Friday."
Said at the end of a call to plan the next step. Example: "Let's follow up on Thursday."

multiple-choice.explanation: Experience: **I have worked** (present perfect) or past simple with a finished time.
options: I have three years of experience.
I am having three years experience.

shadowing.text: Good morning! Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today.
shadowing.tip: Copy the friendly, upbeat energy — not just the words.
shadowing.title: Call opening

shadowing.text: Let me make sure I understand correctly. You need the report every Monday morning?
shadowing.tip: Stress the key words: understand, every Monday morning.
shadowing.title: Confirming requirements

shadowing.text: I can have the first version ready by Friday. Does that work for you?
shadowing.tip: End with a rising tone on the question.
shadowing.title: Committing to a deadline

shadowing.text: Thanks for your patience. I've fixed the issue and everything is working now.
shadowing.tip: Slow down on 'patience' — it's the emotional word here.
shadowing.title: Handling a delay well

checklist: Clear intro of who I am
speak.prompt: Introduce yourself as a freelancer: who you are, what you do, one skill, and what kind of clients you want. 90 seconds.
speak.tip: Imagine a real client on the other end. Smile — it changes your voice.
speak.title: Freelancer intro — 90 seconds

speak.prompt: Tell a STAR story: a problem you faced (in studies, work, or hostel life), what YOU did, and the result. 90 seconds.
speak.tip: Past tense! Went, did, built, fixed, managed.
speak.title: STAR story — 90 seconds
